sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: The six broad modifiers used instead of D&D skills.
When: Use the trait that matches the player's approach.
Not When: Do not translate one D&D skill to one fixed trait every time.
Question: What trait do I use?
Answer: Pick the one that matches how you do it.
Example: Sneaking through brush may be Finesse; sprinting through it may be Agility.
Related: agility strength finesse instinct presence knowledge
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
